title: Vampire Vape Dawn Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Rouse your taste buds with Dawn, a quintessential Vampire Vape creation that boasts a splendid medley of sumptuous fruit flavours with an icy twist. Merging the darkest, sweetest fruits of the forest with an invigorating cool breeze, this exquisite blend harmonises sweet berries with a revitalising menthol finish, culminating in a flavoursome and impeccably balanced e-liquid that promises a smooth and delightful vaping journey. Allow Dawn's enlivening essence to awaken your senses and become a favourite addition to your DIY e-liquid collection. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
